# <span id="aanchor255"></span> Quality Assignment Editor

## Send To Functionality Configuration

The Send To functionality provides for the transfer of analysis data from a meter or location to a quality source. This is useful for propagating an analysis to many meters (‘chromatograph zoning’).

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Meter Send To">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Meter Send To</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Meter Send To">

The meter "Send To" configuration is available when the object type is **Meter** or when the **By Meter** radio button is selected. Click the **Edit** button within the "Send To" group box to alter the configuration.

- **Feed Raw Data -** When this option is enabled, each periodic analysis record contained in a meter's import file will be sent to the source. This is common when a chromatograph is connected to the flow computer. Subsequent edits of analyses records on the meter will not be sent to the source. When this option is not enabled, the meter’s analysis records will be replicated in the source. This is common when a fixed lab analysis is entered into the flow computer because it prevents redundant periodic records from being sent to the source. Subsequent edits of analyses data on the meter will be sent to the source.

Once configured, the meter analyses will be sent to the specified source when data is imported or edited (except as noted in [Configuring Assignments](Configuring%20Assignments.md)). The effective start and end date of the source analysis record will match the meter analysis start and end date.

When meter analysis for a gas meter is sent to a source, if the heating value saturation condition is not specified in the meter, then the composition will be used to calculate the Dry, Saturated, and As Delivered heating values. If the heating value saturation is specified, then the heating value from the meter will be applied to the corresponding real heating value in GQ Source and used to calculate the other real heating values.

If a gas meter has a heating value saturation condition, then the heating value from the meter will populate that heating value in the source and used to calculate the other two heating values. For example: If the meter has a heating value of 1,010 and a heating value saturation of "Dry", then the GQ source will be given a dry heating value of 1,010, and the "Saturated (Wet)" and "As Delivered" heating values will be calculated from this value; otherwise, the "Dry", "Saturated", and "As Delivered" heating values will be calculated from the composition.

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Location Send To">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Location Send To</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Location Send To">

The location "Send To" configuration is available whenever the object type is **Location** or **List** and the **By Location** radio button is selected. Click the **Edit** button within the "Send To" group box to alter the configuration.

- **Data Resolution** - The data resolution of the records to be sent to the source. Options are **Monthly**, **Daily**, and **Hourly**.

- **Include End Date** - The option allows users to decide whether the monthly analysis being sent to the source ends at the end of the month or extends to the end of time. Hourly and daily resolutions always include the end date.

  This option is only available when the "send to" source is a gas quality source and the data resolution is monthly.

Once configured, the location analyses will be sent to the specified source when the location is rolled up and is flagged as "Complete" (except as noted in [Configuring Assignments](Configuring%20Assignments.md)). The effective date of the sent records will be set as the effective date and sample date of the source records.
